mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the breathing chest to the lungs was most worthwhile: the pressure and movement descriptions explain how muscle action draws air in.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to add the lining to the open lung spaces was confusing because the earlier result gave little indication that the lining first needed to join the capillaries.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the air sacs had to connect to the airways before the lining could be used. The comparison of small sacs also helped me understand their greater surface area.

arbitrary.text: The required order for assembling the exchange surface felt a little arbitrary at first, although the resulting picture made its purpose clear.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: connecting breathing and circulation to the needs of working cells made me curious about how the remaining body systems fit together.
